grades.title: Grades
grades.subtitle: Monthly journal, 100-point system. Columns are lesson dates, the last column is the average.
grades.chooseHint: Pick a class and press Show — the subject is selected automatically. If you teach several subjects, switch it in the list.
grades.needClass: Choose a class to open the journal.
grades.noSubjects: No subject is assigned to you in this class. Grades can only be given for subjects you teach.
grades.noClasses: No lessons are assigned to you. Check the timetable. Being a homeroom teacher is not enough — only the subject teacher can grade.
grades.noDates: No lesson days for this subject in this month. Try another month.
grades.noStudents: This class has no active students.
grades.gridHint: Enter a whole number from 0 to 100.
grades.clearHint: An empty cell means no grade. To remove a saved grade, clear the cell and save.
